name: Lengsel
description: '''Lengsel''' was a [[progressive metal|progressive]] [[black metal]] band formed in 1994 in Norway. They released one album, ''[[Solace (Lengsel album)|Solace]]'', on Endtime Productions in 2000, which was licensed to [[Solid State Records]] for an American release. The second album, ''[[The Kiss, the Hope]]'', was released in 2007. Their name means "longing" in [[Norwegian language|Norwegian]]. Longing for home is a prominent theme on their debut release.
